profile.description: Abol Coffee — Hayahulet / 22 Mazoria, Addis Ababa.

Meet Chef Tesfaye — A Culinary Journey Rooted in Passion

Born and raised in the vibrant heart of Addis Ababa, Chef Tesfaye — widely known by his nickname Mokodo — is the third child in his family. His culinary journey began just steps from his childhood home, where one of Addis Ababa’s most iconic pizzerias stood. A place that quickly became his second classroom.

Every afternoon after school, Tesfaye would linger outside, captivated by the rhythm of the kitchen and the artistry behind each pizza. His fascination grew into determination, and before long, he was invited behind the counter to learn the craft directly from seasoned pizzaiolos. That moment sparked a lifelong devotion to authentic Italian cuisine.

Over the years, Chef Tesfaye has trained a new generation of chefs and introduced a wave of innovative brick-oven pizzerias across Ethiopia. In 2020, he proudly opened his first independently owned restaurant, a space that reflects his unwavering commitment to quality and tradition. Every dish is crafted with premium ingredients imported directly from Italy, honoring the flavors that first inspired him.

Now, it’s your turn to taste the legacy. Welcome to Chef Tesfaye’s world, where passion meets perfection, one slice at a time.
